title: Je signe (===)
summary: A per-visit hand signature minted as a JavaScript Symbol; forgeries built from its byte-identical description are always unequal, staging the aura as reference-identity.
mechanism: ECMAScript Symbol() unique identity vs Symbol.for() registry copy: forgery === original is always false though the description string reproduces perfectly; held in closure, nothing stored or sent.
references: Ben Vautier, Je signe / Tout est art (Fluxus)
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
Marcel Duchamp, R. Mutt signature on Fountain (1917)
